therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: dual VEGFR2/EGFR/RET inhibition combined with proteasome inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: angiogenesis inhibition and protein degradation disruption
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: adults with locally advanced or metastatic medullary thyroid cancer
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: maximum tolerated dose (Phase I) and tumor response/progression-free survival (Phase II)

results.effect_size: Phase I MTD: vandetanib 300 mg daily, bortezomib 1.3 mg/m²; Phase II PFS: 3.67 months (combination arm)
results.target_engagement_evidence: vandetanib exposure comparable to literature values; bortezomib clearance reduced by 45% when combined with vandetanib
biomarker_changes: calcitonin partial response in 5/16 Phase I patients
CEA partial response in 2/14 Phase I patients
bortezomib Cmax increased 96% with vandetanib co-administration (p=0.019)
subgroup_findings: Phase I combination arm: 6/21 patients achieved partial response
Phase II combination arm: 0/1 patients achieved response
safety_signals: serious adverse events in Phase I: adrenal insufficiency, bronchopulmonary hemorrhage, hypotension, lymphocyte count decreased
serious adverse events in Phase II: QT prolongation, lung infection

dose_info.schedule: vandetanib daily oral, bortezomib days 1, 4, 8, 11 every 28 days

context.indication: locally advanced or metastatic medullary thyroid cancer
context.investigator_commentary: Terminated due to slow accrual, primary endpoint reached & investigator left NIH.
